question.problem: If $\,\boxed{}\times 25%=90,$ then what is the missing number?
question.worked_solution:
The part is $90,$ the percentage is $25%,$ and we need to find the whole.

To do this, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{whole}=\text{part}÷\text{percentage}
$$

 

Before we can substitute our numbers into the formula, we need to express $25%$ as a fraction:

$$
\frac{25}{100}=\frac{25÷25}{100÷25}=\frac{1}{4}
$$

We can now substitute our numbers into the formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{whole} & =90÷25% \\  & =90÷\frac{1}{4} \\  & =90\times \frac{4}{1} \\  & =90\times 4 \\  & =360\end{aligned}
$$
